fact_text: State Life's Sahan cancer cover for women, the cheapest product in its Sahan range, costs about 2,000 rupees a year, under 200 rupees a month.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Life's Bold New Moves With CEO Shoaib Javed Hussain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-02)

fact_text: The CEO said women in Pakistan have the worst cancer rates and cancer death rates in Asia, which is why State Life developed the Sahan cover.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Life's Bold New Moves With CEO Shoaib Javed Hussain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-02)

fact_text: State Life's Golden Endowment is a savings-and-protection endowment with a minimum premium of 9,000 rupees a year, about 20 to 30 rupees a day, with profits shared with policyholders.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Life's Bold New Moves With CEO Shoaib Javed Hussain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-02)

fact_text: Pakistan's life insurance penetration, premiums as a share of GDP, is below 1 percent, according to the State Life CEO.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Life's Bold New Moves With CEO Shoaib Javed Hussain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-02)

fact_text: State Life said its share of Pakistan's life insurance market rose from about 50 percent to 65 percent over four years, making it the largest life and health insurer.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Life's Bold New Moves With CEO Shoaib Javed Hussain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-02)

fact_text: Pakistan's life insurance premiums were about 125 billion rupees in 2020 and more than 300 billion rupees by 2025, according to the State Life CEO.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Life's Bold New Moves With CEO Shoaib Javed Hussain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-02)

fact_text: State Life says it paid 99.91 percent of its claims on time in 2024.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Life's Bold New Moves With CEO Shoaib Javed Hussain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-02)

fact_text: State Life aims to pay early death claims within about 90 days and says it works to keep claim times as short as possible for policyholders.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Life's Bold New Moves With CEO Shoaib Javed Hussain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-02)

fact_text: The CEO said claim payment is the real business of insurance and not an expense, so timely claim settlement is central to the model.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Life's Bold New Moves With CEO Shoaib Javed Hussain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-02)

fact_text: About 15 to 16 percent of State Life's life fund, roughly 330 billion rupees, is invested in the stock market, the CEO said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Life's Bold New Moves With CEO Shoaib Javed Hussain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-02)

fact_text: Government bonds make up about 70 percent of State Life's investment book, roughly 1.4 to 1.5 trillion rupees.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Life's Bold New Moves With CEO Shoaib Javed Hussain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-02)

fact_text: State Life's investment policy aims to raise returns for policyholders and shareholders while keeping enough liquidity to pay claims whenever they arise.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Life's Bold New Moves With CEO Shoaib Javed Hussain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-02)

fact_text: State Life was recognised by PICG for adopting top corporate governance rules, with board and management committees and internal, external and government audits.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Life's Bold New Moves With CEO Shoaib Javed Hussain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-02)

fact_text: State Life insures farmers who buy fertiliser bags from a registered fertiliser partner, with cover of up to about 1 million rupees per farmer per year included in the bag price.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Life's Bold New Moves With CEO Shoaib Javed Hussain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-02)

fact_text: State Life sells per-ride digital accident and hospitalisation cover to app-based delivery and ride-hailing riders, bought in the app and verified against ride records.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Life's Bold New Moves With CEO Shoaib Javed Hussain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-02)

fact_text: State Life received a voluntary pension scheme licence from the SECP in 2025 and plans to launch it, paying an annuity after retirement.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Life's Bold New Moves With CEO Shoaib Javed Hussain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-02)

fact_text: State Life's corporate health plans let retired employees keep their cover on the same premium, which the CEO said is more affordable for individuals than buying alone.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Life's Bold New Moves With CEO Shoaib Javed Hussain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-02)
